risk_registry.description: Infrastructure recursion trap: teams drift from domain work into building coordination infrastructure, repeating the pattern that produced zero domain output across Teams 22-28 (7 consecutive sessions)
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Enforce SOP-023 at every session: pre-launch agent tally (AR-01 >= 60% domain), mid-session drift check at checkpoint 3, post-session audit of actual domain/infra split. Coordinator must immediately redirect any agent proposing new coordination modules.
risk_registry.detection_method: Pre-launch: domain agent count < 60%. Mid-session: any agent working in storage/coordination/ on non-bug-fix tasks. Post-session: session log shows < 60% domain work or zero domain artifacts.
risk_registry.escalation_path: Coordinator halts infrastructure work immediately. If coordinator is the source, any agent can invoke SOP-023 Section 3 warning sign protocol. Session log must document the drift event.

risk_registry.description: Session 1 fails to produce any market picks, extending the zero-output streak to 15+ sessions. This is the single most important risk across the entire roadmap.
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Session 1 has ZERO prerequisites and ZERO infrastructure dependencies. All tools exist (WebSearch, WebFetch). Methods documented in market-research/methods/. TEMPLATE.md ready. Coordinator enforces zero infrastructure work. Time-box: sector screening 10 min, stock screening 15 min.
risk_registry.detection_method: 30 minutes into session: if no candidate stocks identified, trigger escalation. 60 minutes: if no pick file started, session is failing.
risk_registry.escalation_path: Reduce scope to 1-2 high-conviction picks. Drop multi-method validation. Use a single method (fundamental.md) on obvious large-cap candidates. Better 1 adequate pick than 0 perfect picks.

risk_registry.description: Pick quality too low to be useful: first-ever picks lack rigor, contain stale data, or have unsupported theses, undermining credibility of the entire market research capability
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Apply 10-point pick quality checklist from quality_framework. Every pick must pass at least 8 of 10 criteria. Cross-reference data from 2+ sources. Include data timestamps. Coordinator quality-gates picks before final logging.
risk_registry.detection_method: Writer/Indexer runs pick quality checklist on each pick before committing. Any pick failing < 8/10 criteria is flagged for revision.
risk_registry.escalation_path: Pick failing quality gate goes back to research team for remediation. If data unavailable, document gap explicitly and reduce confidence score. Never log a pick that fails business clarity, valuation, or risk assessment gates.

risk_registry.description: Critical TOCTOU bugs (WS-001, HP-001) cause silent data loss during multi-agent coordination, corrupting work results or leaving inconsistent help request state
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Session 1 uses pure research workflow (no work_stealing or help_protocol). Fix WS-001 and HP-001 in Session 4 (roadmap schedule). Until fixed, avoid multi-agent patterns that trigger complete_work or fulfill_help race conditions.
risk_registry.detection_method: Monitor for ValueErrors or unexpected state in work_stealing and help_protocol logs. Run stress tests (test_toctou_fixes.py pattern) after each fix.
risk_registry.escalation_path: If data loss detected: stop multi-agent ops, switch to single-agent mode per SOP-021. Apply fix immediately per SOP-020 bug fix workflow. Write regression test before fix.

risk_registry.description: Data hygiene debt misleads future teams: 15 orphaned scripts, 34 missing KB titles, unindexed session, and duplicate FRED source cause teams to miss available tools or make decisions based on stale information
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Session 4 is dedicated to data hygiene sprint. Quick fixes (BF-001 orphaned scripts, BF-005 TEAM-0032 indexing) can be done opportunistically in earlier sessions if time allows. KB title backfill is scriptable.
risk_registry.detection_method: Run validate_naming.py and auto_index.py to detect orphans and drift. Compare filesystem against index.json entry counts.
risk_registry.escalation_path: If data hygiene blocks domain work (e.g., team cannot find needed tool), fix immediately as emergency maintenance. Otherwise queue for Session 4.

risk_registry.description: API rate limit exhaustion during market research: Alpha Vantage reduced to 25 calls/day, Finnhub at 60/min, no cost tracking exists to monitor consumption
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Session 1 uses WebSearch/WebFetch (no rate limits). Session 2 adopts MCP servers with fallback to WebSearch. Yahoo Finance Stockflow has no auth requirement. Stagger API calls. Cache results within session.
risk_registry.detection_method: HTTP 429 responses from APIs. Track API call count manually until cost_tracker built.
risk_registry.escalation_path: On rate limit hit: switch to alternative source (WebSearch, different MCP server). Use exponential backoff per SOP-021. If all sources exhausted, use cached data from earlier in session and document staleness.

risk_registry.description: Duplicate work across sessions: teams re-research stocks already analyzed, create duplicate KB entries, or rebuild tools that already exist
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Pre-session: search existing picks by ticker, search KB by topic, check scripts index. Use dedup_checker (TB-006) when available. Each session starts by reviewing prior session outputs.
risk_registry.detection_method: Pre-session search of market-research/picks/ for ticker symbols under consideration. KB search for topic overlap.
risk_registry.escalation_path: If duplicate detected pre-creation: merge new data into existing entry. If duplicate detected post-creation: merge and delete duplicate, update indexes.

risk_registry.description: MCP server installation fails or returns unusable data, blocking Session 2's financial data integration objective
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Yahoo Finance Stockflow requires no auth and is simplest to adopt. Time-box MCP setup to 15 minutes. Fall back to WebSearch (proven in Session 1) if MCP setup stalls. Do not build custom API scripts.
risk_registry.detection_method: MCP server returns valid data for test ticker within 15 minutes of setup start.
risk_registry.escalation_path: 15 min timeout: abandon problematic server, try next one. 30 min with no working server: abort MCP integration, use WebSearch for this session, retry MCP in Session 3.

risk_registry.description: SEC EDGAR XBRL parsing complexity exceeds single-session scope, causing Session 3 coding agent to consume all time on tool building with no domain output
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Start with simple JSON endpoints (company search, recent filings list). XBRL parsing is stretch goal, not required. Core value is filing access, not full data extraction. Time-box to 45 minutes.
risk_registry.detection_method: 45 minutes: if tool cannot fetch basic filing list for a test ticker, scope is too ambitious.
risk_registry.escalation_path: Ship minimal tool (filing list + metadata only, no XBRL parsing). Domain teams use WebSearch to read actual filing content. Iterate on XBRL in future session.

risk_registry.description: Infrastructure bug fixes in Session 4 expand in scope beyond the planned 5 items, consuming domain work capacity
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Limit to exactly the items listed in roadmap: 15 orphaned scripts, TEAM-0032 indexing, 34 KB titles, TOCTOU-WS-001, TOCTOU-HP-001, TOCTOU-MTR-004, FRED duplicate merge. No scope expansion. One infrastructure agent only.
risk_registry.detection_method: Infrastructure agent modifying files not in the approved fix list. Infrastructure agent still working on fixes past 60-minute mark.
risk_registry.escalation_path: Coordinator halts scope expansion. Remaining items go to deferred backlog. Infrastructure agent reassigned to domain work if fixes complete early.

risk_registry.description: Stale or incorrect market data leads to picks with wrong entry prices, outdated financials, or invalidated theses
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Cross-reference every key metric from 2+ independent sources. Include data_timestamp in pick file. Flag any data older than 5 trading days. Use real-time data from MCP servers when available (Session 2+).
risk_registry.detection_method: Pick quality checklist items 9 (Multi-Source) and 10 (Data Freshness). Session 4 portfolio review catches stale data in earlier picks.
risk_registry.escalation_path: If data discrepancy found between sources: use more conservative figure, document discrepancy, note reduced confidence.

risk_registry.description: Efficiency collapse from team oversizing: per-agent efficiency drops 89% at scale (4.0 solo vs 0.44 at 27 agents) per historical data
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: All sessions use 5-agent teams per SOP-022 SIZE-03. No session exceeds 8 agents. Think tank to coding ratio <= 1:2. Pre-launch sizing check.
risk_registry.detection_method: Pre-launch: team size check against SOP-022. Mid-session: idle agent detection via heartbeat monitoring.
risk_registry.escalation_path: Idle agents get reassigned to domain work or standby queue. If 2+ agents idle simultaneously, reduce team size for next session.

risk_registry.description: Agent Skill format (Session 5) is poorly documented, causing packaging effort to exceed budget and steal time from domain work
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Agent Skill is a .skill.md file with structured instructions per agentskills.io standard. Low complexity. Time-box to 30 minutes. If format unclear, write a plain markdown workflow document instead.
risk_registry.detection_method: 30 minutes into packaging: if no draft .skill.md exists, format research is taking too long.
risk_registry.escalation_path: Abandon .skill.md format. Package as a detailed markdown guide in storage/skills/. Functional equivalence without format compliance.

risk_registry.description: TOCTOU bug fixes introduce regressions in coordination system, breaking previously working multi-agent operations
risk_registry.mitigation_strategy: Write regression test BEFORE implementing fix (test-first). Run full test suite after each fix. Fixes are small and targeted (add BEGIN IMMEDIATE + WHERE guards). Follow SOP-020 minimal fix principle.
risk_registry.detection_method: Full test suite run after each fix. Stress tests (threading.Barrier pattern from test_toctou_fixes.py) for concurrency fixes.
risk_registry.escalation_path: If regression detected: revert fix immediately. Analyze why regression occurred. Re-implement with smaller scope. Never ship a fix that breaks existing tests.

bugs_to_fix.root_cause: SELECT to check authorization followed by UPDATE without BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Between check and update, another process can reclaim and reassign the work item.
bugs_to_fix.impact: Work results silently lost. One team's output overwrites another's.

bugs_to_fix.root_cause: Two separate UPDATEs (help_requests + work_items) not wrapped in BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Crash between them leaves inconsistent state.
bugs_to_fix.impact: Help request marked fulfilled but work item not completed, or vice versa.

bugs_to_fix.root_cause: No guard against double invocation from signal handler + main thread.
bugs_to_fix.impact: Double _close_connection call and duplicate shutdown messages.

fix_patterns.implementation: Replace separate SELECT + UPDATE with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Add WHERE clause to UPDATE that includes the expected current state (claimed_by=? AND status='claimed'). Check cursor.rowcount == 1 after UPDATE. ROLLBACK and raise ValueError if rowcount != 1.
fix_patterns.example_sql: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; UPDATE work_items SET status='completed', result=? WHERE id=? AND claimed_by=? AND status='claimed'; -- check rowcount; COMMIT;

fix_patterns.implementation: Wrap both UPDATEs in a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Add WHERE guards to each UPDATE. Check rowcount after each. ROLLBACK entire transaction if any check fails.
fix_patterns.example_sql: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; UPDATE help_requests SET status='fulfilled' WHERE id=? AND status='accepted' AND accepted_by_team=?; -- check rowcount; UPDATE work_items SET status='completed' WHERE id=?; -- check rowcount; COMMIT;

fix_patterns.implementation: Add threading.Event self._stopped. At entry to stop(): if self._stopped.is_set(): return. Otherwise self._stopped.set() and proceed. Initialize self._stopped = threading.Event() in __init__.

test_requirements.approach: Threading stress test with Barrier. 15 threads attempt to complete the same work item simultaneously. Exactly 1 must succeed, N-1 must get ValueError. No silent data loss.
Threading stress test with Barrier. 12 threads attempt to fulfill the same help request. Exactly 1 must succeed. DB state must be consistent (both help_requests and work_items updated or neither).
Call stop() from two threads simultaneously using Barrier. Verify _close_connection called exactly once. Verify no duplicate shutdown messages.
